sermon.title: God talks back - August 27, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: After worship to the great I AM and a special song about the red letters, the Job series continues. God blesses naturally and spiritually but also tests the righteous to refine them; in Job 38 God finally speaks and questions Job, and the message asks whether we want to hear His voice and will keep serving Him, fearing God and keeping His commandments.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with a long worship set and a special song (“Red Letters”), lyrics as captioned; the message begins at about 30:16. He cites “Psalms 11:5” and “Ephesians chapter 1:3”.

faqs.question: Does God’s provision mean I don’t have to work?
faqs.answer: No; it’s not working and saying God, rain down hamburgers from heaven.

faqs.question: Why is a rich man afraid to die?
faqs.answer: Because he doesn’t know God and has no security about what will happen to him.

faqs.question: Does he want more testing?
faqs.answer: He jokes that God has a calendar and can test him on it; he doesn’t want to add more places to it.

faqs.question: Can you just throw money at God?
faqs.answer: No; living the wicked life and offering something is like come on man, get with the program.

faqs.question: Is a bad thought a sin?
faqs.answer: He says not until it comes out of your mouth or you do something.

faqs.question: How long is Job?
faqs.answer: He calls it a big book, about 40 chapters, mostly conversations.

faqs.question: Why compare ourselves to others?
faqs.answer: Like bodybuilders on stage, we compare, but if anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

faqs.question: Can we stop animals from migrating?
faqs.answer: He asks if you can stop the whales or birds from going from Alaska to Hawaii.

faqs.question: Where can I start keeping God’s commandments?
faqs.answer: Look up the Ten Commandments; that’s a great start.

faqs.question: Is the purpose of life to be happy?
faqs.answer: Joy is part of the program, but the conclusion is fear God and keep His commandments.
